races.paceDynamic: Mind Over Matter is the clear front runner with prominent tendencies, likely to lead from the gates without serious pressure. Le Puy, Stoneacre Joe, and Railwayman will sit in prominent positions behind, but none are aggressive early pace pressers. The moderate early gallop will allow the field to stay compact through halfway, setting up a sustained drive from the 2f pole. This race shape strongly favours prominent runners and those with tactical pace who can position close to the leaders, as the lack of early burn will see the race develop into a sprint finish where early position proves crucial.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Lead Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Mind Over Matter gets an easy lead and the prominent pack doesn't organize pressure
scenarios.body: The loose leader dictates fractions and kicks clear when the real running begins, while those tracking struggle to close the gap in time. Horses that raced prominently but couldn't lay up close enough find themselves outkicked.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Pack Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent runners (Le Puy, Stoneacre Joe, Railwayman) apply measured pressure and travel strongly
scenarios.body: The race develops into a proper test where the horses with the best tactical speed from prominent positions can quicken decisively in the final furlong. Mind Over Matter gets caught by superior finishing kicks from those who raced handy.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes surprisingly strong early or the leaders compound too quickly
scenarios.body: The early pace takes its toll on the front division, allowing a well-ridden hold-up horse with tactical pace to come through late. Mac's Wee Sister or April Diamond could benefit from a strong early gallop that sets up their finishing kick.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Thistle Nil Unknown Factor
scenarios.trigger: If the lightly-raced Thistle Nil possesses significantly superior ability that hasn't been exposed yet
scenarios.body: The high-rated newcomer overcomes pace positioning through sheer class, regardless of how the race unfolds tactically. Jim Goldie's charge shows a turn of foot that the others simply cannot match.

watchPoints.text: Mind Over Matter could get too easy a lead if the prominent pack fails to apply any pressure early
Watch Thistle Nil's market movements as the lightly-raced high-rated runner represents the biggest unknown
Stoneacre Joe's recent second suggests peak form and could be the main danger to the leader
The 239-day break for Mind Over Matter could tell late despite the early advantage
Watch how aggressively Le Puy and Railwayman position early as they could dictate tactical flow

races.paceDynamic: Canaria Queen will be the natural pace-setter from her prominent style, likely joined early by Ski Angel who also shows pace tendencies. With only two horses willing to go forward in an 11-runner field, they'll set a steady but uncontested gallop over this sharp 5f trip. The large pack of hold-up horses including Harb, Tommy McJohn, Keep The Gold, Wee Mary, Royal Duke, Fear And Fast, Little Mi Mi and Bonito Cavalo will be bunched behind them waiting to pounce. This race shape strongly favours the early leaders who can dictate terms without pressure, as the hold-up brigade will face a wall of horses when trying to find racing room in the sprint home.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Front Two Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Canaria Queen and Ski Angel get soft fractions and kick clear
scenarios.body: The pace-setters exploit their tactical advantage by opening up before the field can organize a response. Hold-up horses get caught in traffic as the leaders capitalize on their positional supremacy.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Charge Succeeds
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is too generous and the front pair tie up
scenarios.body: The large group of hold-up horses finally get the setup they need with strong pace to aim at. Quality horses like Harb and Keep The Gold can use their superior ratings to close strongly.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Pacemaker Crack Opens Door
scenarios.trigger: If Ski Angel fades but Canaria Queen maintains her effort
scenarios.body: One front-runner weakens but the other holds on as the hold-up horses still struggle with the lack of early pace. A mid-pack horse like Wee Mary could benefit from the slight opening created.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Complete Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If both front-runners go too fast early and completely tie up
scenarios.body: An unexpectedly strong early gallop sets up perfectly for the closers who finally get the race shape they need. The highest-rated hold-up horses can showcase their ability.

watchPoints.text: Watch for Canaria Queen to get easy early fractions - she could prove very hard to peg back if unopposed
Monitor how aggressively Ski Angel commits to challenging early - too keen could compromise both front-runners
Check if any hold-up horses get prominent early positions unexpectedly - would change entire race dynamic
Observe if the large group of closers can organize an effective challenge despite lack of early pace
Watch for traffic problems in home straight with 9+ horses likely to be closely bunched turning in

races.paceDynamic: Coconut Bay emerges as the sole confirmed pace-setter, having shown prominent tendencies and likely to take them along at a sustainable gallop without early pressure. With seven of the nine runners adopting hold-up tactics (Ashen, Jkr Cobbler, Habrdi, Camera Shy, Little Ted, Trais Fluors, Approaching Dawn), this creates a bunched field tracking the leader into the straight. The lack of pace pressure early means Coconut Bay can dictate terms before the field unleashes late, but the weight of numbers suggests those with tactical speed from off the pace will have the final say. This race shape strongly favours prominent runners and those hold-up horses with proven finishing kicks over pure front-runners or those needing strong early pace.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Coconut Bay Controls Tempo
scenarios.trigger: If Coconut Bay gets uncontested lead and dictates moderate fractions
scenarios.body: The veteran can string out the field on the turn and hold off late challengers who leave their runs too late. His experience at the trip and proven course form gives him every chance when allowed easy lead.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Brigade Swamps Leader
scenarios.trigger: If the pace is too slow and multiple hold-up horses deliver simultaneously
scenarios.body: Coconut Bay gets swamped in final furlong as Ashen, Camera Shy and Jkr Cobbler all arrive with late runs. The sheer weight of numbers from behind overwhelms the lone pace-setter.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Little Ted's Tactical Speed
scenarios.trigger: If Little Ted gets prominent position and kicks clear before others respond
scenarios.body: The nine-year-old uses his experience to track Coconut Bay before making winning move two furlongs out. His recent placed efforts suggest he's ready to strike when getting ideal positioning.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Camera Shy Late Surge
scenarios.trigger: If Camera Shy gets clear run and produces career-best effort under headgear
scenarios.body: Tudhope times run to perfection as Camera Shy finds extra gear in final 100 yards that his breeding suggests is there. The tongue-tie change sparks improvement at crucial moment.

watchPoints.text: Coconut Bay must be watched for market support as the lone pace-setter could steal this if getting easy lead

races.paceDynamic: Runninsonofagun and Glasses Up will engage from the off, with both confirmed front-runners likely to dispute the early lead in this 1m1f contest. The veteran Glasses Up has shown recent form and will press hard, while Runninsonofagun returns after 190 days but has natural pace. This setup creates an honest gallop that should suit horses with tactical speed who can position prominently or track the pace. The race shape clearly favours prominent racers and those with finishing kicks over pure hold-up horses, as the strong pace will set up a searching test.

scenarios.label: A

scenarios.trigger: If both front-runners go too hard early and fade in the straight

scenarios.label: B

races.paceDynamic: Donna Nook will take the field along from the front with no obvious challengers for the early lead, creating a controlled tempo that won't stretch the field. The remaining six runners (Pearl Eye, Novak, Eve's Boy, Starliner, Penelope's Sister, Rajapour) all carry hold-up styles, meaning they'll track the leader in a compact group before attempting their finishing kicks. With just one pace-setter against six closers, the tempo will be modest early before quickening late. This race shape strongly favours the front-runner and prominent racers who can secure good positions early, as the lack of pace pressure will allow Donna Nook to dictate terms.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Donna Nook maintains a steady gallop and kicks clear turning for home
scenarios.body: The lone leader will have too much in reserve against hold-up horses who face a traffic-laden finish from the back. Donna Nook's prominent style becomes the winning formula when she's unopposed early.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Kick Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes pedestrian and the field bunches turning in
scenarios.body: A strong closer with the best turn of foot will sweep past the tiring leader in the final furlong. Eve's Boy or Rajapour could benefit from their class edge in a sprint finish.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Traffic Chaos Benefits
scenarios.trigger: If the hold-up brigade gets bottled up behind the leader
scenarios.body: Horses tracking closest to Donna Nook will have first run on the weakening leader while others are still finding racing room. This favours those who can position prominently despite their hold-up labels.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If Donna Nook goes too slowly and gets swamped by the field
scenarios.body: An unexpectedly crawling tempo allows all six closers to finish strongly together in a blanket finish. The horse with the best recent form edge will prevail in a cavalry charge.

races.paceDynamic: Iris Dancer will take this field along from the front with no other confirmed leaders to challenge her early. The prominent runners Taygar, Tarlac, The Gay Blade and Filly's Last Lady will track behind in a pack, creating a moderate gallop over the minimum trip. With hold-up horses Colour Code and Summerstorms Dream at the back, this sets up as a straightforward affair where the front group will likely dominate. This pace scenario strongly favours prominent runners who can sit close to Iris Dancer and pounce in the final furlong when her sustainable lead becomes vulnerable.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the pace stays moderate and Iris Dancer sets reasonable fractions
scenarios.body: The tracking pack of Taygar, The Gay Blade, Tarlac and Filly's Last Lady will be perfectly positioned to strike in the final two furlongs. Iris Dancer's lack of pressure early means she won't soften up enough for the hold-up horses to be effective.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Holds On
scenarios.trigger: If Iris Dancer gets easy lead fractions and the prominent runners don't coordinate their challenge
scenarios.body: Her veteran guile and three wins from this style could see her kick clear approaching the furlong pole before the chasers can respond. The short straight at Ayr suits her front-running tactics perfectly.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Late Surge Success
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes truly pedestrian and the field bunches up entering the final two furlongs
scenarios.body: Summerstorms Dream and Colour Code could benefit from a sprint finish if they overcome their style disadvantages. However, both face significant form and tactical concerns that make this unlikely.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If Iris Dancer goes too slow early and the race becomes a complete lottery in the final furlong
scenarios.body: Any horse could win from a crawling pace that turns into a dash, but this seems unlikely given Iris Dancer's honest front-running style. The prominent runners would still hold positional advantages.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Ebony Maw Controls Pace
scenarios.trigger: If Ebony Maw gets an easy lead and dictates moderate fractions
